_comment: Per-(case_id, GPU device name) golden for DeepSeek-V4 module microbenchmarks. These are ISOLATED-OP continuous gpu_time gates: gate = baseline_ms*(1+max(k_sigma*cv, rel_floor)), defaults k_sigma=4 rel_floor=0.01. Empty case map => bootstrap (test prints observed, does not fail). GPU key is torch.cuda.get_device_name (== CSV gpu_name), NOT sm_arch. baseline_ms values are placeholders until a real run bootstraps them on the target GPU. NOTE: model-level kernel launch counts (e.g. mhcGemmSqrsumFmaKernel=7119 over a full CTX layer-slice) are NOT isolated-op signals and are validated separately against the layerwise nsys trace, not here.
